game_title: Max Finder Derby – Woodcutter Clearing Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Woodcutter Clearing, a woodcutter's clearing: the forest ranger must handle cursed treants while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Max Finder Derby: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants.
theme: Mystic Forest – Woodcutter Clearing: a woodcutter's clearing
core_gameplay_loop: In Woodcutter Clearing, repeat each round: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the best value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the fairy lantern using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The fairy lantern reached with actions_used <= 15.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the fairy lantern is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Max Finder Derby
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
